message:
I can't be the only one who's experienced that sinking feeling when my phone starts to die right when I need it most—especially during a blackout! 🌩️ It's a good reminder of how important it is to be prepared for those unexpected moments. I recently came across some helpful tips from a well-known resource that walks you through what to do during a power outage, including how to keep your devices charged and stay connected. 

Having a plan in place really helps ease the stress, and it's all about being ready for anything. What’s your go-to tip for staying calm and connected when the lights go out?
